name: Linear
tagline: The object model is small: issues, states, labels, cycles, projects. A keyboard-first single-player tracker with a board, cycles, and one-way GitHub sync is a weekend build. What does not survive the copy is the sync engine, real-time multiplayer, and the integration surface (GitHub two-way, Slack, Figma, Sentry) that make Linear the place a team actually agrees on what is being built.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Linear costs $10/mo ($120/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
